proposed.text: Under the average end area method, two end areas are 150 sq ft and 475 sq ft, and the length is 50 ft. What is the earthwork volume in cubic yards?
proposed.rationale: Average the end areas first, then multiply by length and divide by 27: [(150 + 475) / 2] x 50 / 27 = 578.7 cu yd, rounded to 579 cu yd.
